# Implementation Plan: M5 Settlement & Reporting

**Branch**: `005-settlement` | **Date**: 2025-11-16 | **Spec**: `/home/explorer/Development/rnexchange/specs/005-settlement/spec.md`  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/005-settlement/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit.plan` for RNExchange and aligns with the RNExchange Constitution.

## Summary

Implement M5 Settlement & Reporting as the simulated, internal-price EOD phase that precedes full Kite integration. This feature provides an Exchange Operator-triggered end-of-day (EOD) batch that marks all open positions to internal mock prices, posts variation P&L to ledgers, and generates accessible daily statements and broker summaries for Traders and Broker Admins. The technical approach reuses existing JHipster 8 single-app stack (Spring Boot + React), the `DailySettlementPrice`, `Position`, `LedgerEntry`, and `SettlementBatch` entities, and mock market data; adds a dedicated settlement service and REST endpoints (API-first via OpenAPI); and introduces lightweight HTML statement views and broker-level summary reports without any Kite or external feed dependencies, thereby laying the foundation for the constitution’s M5 Kite Integration milestone.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Java (Spring Boot via JHipster 8) for backend; TypeScript/React 18 for frontend  
**Primary Dependencies**: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Web/WebSocket, JPA/Hibernate, Liquibase, MapStruct, JHipster React stack (Redux Toolkit, React Router), Jest/RTL, Cypress, Gatling  
**Storage**: PostgreSQL via Liquibase-managed schema; reuse `DailySettlementPrice`, `Position`, `LedgerEntry`, `SettlementBatch`, `TradingAccount`, and introduce a simple report-link mapping if needed for statements/summaries  
**Testing**: JUnit 5 (unit + integration), contract tests generated from OpenAPI, Jest/RTL for React components, Cypress for key flows (EOD run, statement view, broker reports), Gatling for EOD performance where relevant  
**Target Platform**: Linux server, containerized via existing JHipster Docker Compose/Jib setup  
**Project Type**: Web application (single JHipster monolith with backend + frontend in one repo)  
**Performance Goals**: EOD settlement completes for up to ~10,000 positions within 5 minutes (per constitution); batch endpoints remain responsive (trigger + polling pattern rather than long-blocking HTTP)  
**Constraints**: TDD (tests before implementation), API-first (OpenAPI → codegen → implementation), strict RBAC (`TRADER`, `BROKER_ADMIN`, `EXCHANGE_OPERATOR`), no Kite/external feed calls in this feature, single-pass deterministic batch (no partial retries), and reuse mock market data only  
**Scale/Scope**: Milestone M5 scope for settlement & reporting; multiple brokers with 10s–100s of traders each, generating up to tens of thousands of positions and statements per EOD.

## Constitution Check

_GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design._

- TDD enforced: Plan includes contract, integration, and UI tests authored before settlement service and UI implementation — **PASS**
- JHipster conventions: Entities remain in JDL; changes (e.g., new `LedgerEntryType` values or report-link entity) go through JDL + Liquibase; layered architecture (domain → repository → service → REST) preserved — **PASS**
- RBAC: New endpoints will be guarded with `@PreAuthorize` for `EXCHANGE_OPERATOR`, `BROKER_ADMIN`, and `TRADER` as appropriate, with broker/account scoping enforced at service/repository layers — **PASS**
- Real-Time Architecture: EOD uses existing mock market data and 1-minute bars; no new WebSocket topics are required for this feature, but existing real-time pricing remains the source for fallback settlement prices — **PASS**
- API-First: All settlement, batch, statement, and broker summary endpoints will be defined in OpenAPI under `src/main/resources/swagger/api.yml` (via this feature’s contracts) before backend implementation and code generation — **PASS**
- DDD: Settlement behavior will be encapsulated in dedicated domain services using existing entities (`Position`, `LedgerEntry`, `SettlementBatch`, `DailySettlementPrice`), and will publish explicit domain events (for example, `SettlementCompletedEvent`, `SettlementFailedEvent`) for EOD completion and failure — **PASS**
- Educational Transparency: Statements and summaries will clearly label the environment as simulated and explain that prices/P&L are from internal mock feeds — **PASS**

No violations are anticipated. If we introduce a new report-link entity or additional ledger/settlement enums, they will be modeled via JDL and Liquibase with corresponding tests.

Post-Phase 1 re-check: Contracts, data model, and quickstart will reflect API-first, RBAC, TDD, and EOD performance constraints — expected **PASS**.

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
src/main/java/com/rnexchange/                  # JHipster backend (monolith)
├── domain/                                    # Existing entities (Position, LedgerEntry, SettlementBatch, DailySettlementPrice, TradingAccount)
├── repository/                                # Repositories for domain entities
├── service/                                   # Domain services
│   ├── settlement/                            # New settlement service(s) for EOD batch, statements
│   └── dto/                                   # DTOs for API responses if needed

src/main/resources/
├── config/
├── swagger/
│   └── api.yml                                # Central OpenAPI; will be updated with settlement/reporting endpoints
└── db/changelog/                              # Liquibase changesets for any new enum values/entities (e.g., report link)

src/main/webapp/app/
├── modules/exchange/settlement/               # Exchange Operator settlement tab (batch list, Run EOD)
├── modules/broker/settlements/                # Broker Admin settlements/reports tab
└── modules/trader/statements/                 # Trader daily statements view

src/test/java/com/rnexchange/
├── contract/                                  # Contract tests mapped from OpenAPI
├── integration/                               # E2E EOD batch, ledger, and reporting flows
└── unit/                                      # Service-level tests for settlement calculations

src/test/javascript/
├── cypress/                                   # UI tests for EOD run and statement/report screens
└── spec/                                      # Jest/RTL tests for React components
```

**Structure Decision**: Single JHipster monorepo (backend + frontend). Settlement logic will live under `service/settlement` and `web/rest/settlement` while UI additions are implemented as role-scoped modules under `app/modules`. Contracts are centralized in `src/main/resources/swagger/api.yml` following the API-first rule.
